name: Garments of the Light

meta.previous: In Favor of the Light (Elwynn Forest)
chain: In Favor of the Light (Elwynn Forest)

summary: At Goldshire, Garments of the Light mark a novice priest’s first trial under Priestess Josetta. She sends you east to Crystal Lake to tend the wounded Guard Roberts. The work tests your healing and earns you vestments recognized by the Church of the Holy Light.

sections.title: A Practical Test of Faith
sections.body: Priestess Josetta teaches acolytes who come to Goldshire from Northshire Abbey. Before the Church of the Holy Light formally recognizes a novice, she tests their skill with divine power. When Guard Roberts is reported wounded by the lake east of Goldshire, Josetta sends you to care for him. His need gives you a chance to prove your healing in practice.

sections.title: Sustaining the Realm
sections.body: You need to do more than close Guard Roberts’s wounds. Mend him with restorative prayers, then strengthen him with a blessing of fortitude. Stormwind’s forces are stretched thin, and local garrisons face kobolds and bandits. Josetta teaches that priests help defenders endure danger. Healing Roberts will aid the township and show that you can support its guards.

sections.title: Vestments of the Order
sections.body: After treating Guard Roberts, return to the Lion’s Pride Inn. There you receive your first formal robes, a sign of approval and fellowship from the priesthood in Stormwind. The robes are not required for further training, but they show that the Church recognizes you as a servant of the Holy Light.

faq.q: Where can I find Guard Roberts?
faq.answer: Guard Roberts is just east of Goldshire, near Crystal Lake. He rests by the roadside at the water’s edge while recovering from wounds suffered on watch.

faq.q: What spells are required to complete this quest?
aliases: what spells do i cast on roberts
faq.answer: Use Lesser Heal Rank 2 to restore Guard Roberts’s health, then cast Power Word: Fortitude to strengthen him. Return to Priestess Josetta afterward.

aliases: who gives garments of the light
faq.answer: Priestess Josetta trains priests for the Church of the Holy Light at the Lion’s Pride Inn in Goldshire. She guides young acolytes from Northshire Abbey in practical service and divine magic.

faq.q: Why does the Church give out robes for this task?
faq.answer: The robes show that the Church of the Holy Light approves of the acolyte and supports their ministry. Caring for Guard Roberts demonstrates the skill and discipline needed to wear the church’s vestments.

faq.q: Can other classes complete this quest?
aliases: is garments of the light priest only
can paladins do garments of the light
faq.answer: No. Only Alliance priests can complete this trial in their introductory training, after learning fundamental healing and warding prayers.

faq.q: What happens after completing Garments of the Light?
aliases: next quest after garments of the light
faq.answer: After you complete the early priest training in Goldshire, there is no immediate follow-up. Priestess Josetta and other trainers throughout the kingdom offer further training and trials as you gain experience.

angles.text: As a priest, you carry your learning from Northshire into service in the field. Healing and fortifying allies helps keep those on the front line alive.
As an Alliance member, you see how local church disciples help town guards hold their ground while Stormwind’s army is stretched thin and absent from hamlets.
As a human, you belong to a culture that honors the Church of the Holy Light. Earning vestments from a township priestess marks an important civic and spiritual milestone.
